newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via 8-day or overnight RP.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via 8-day or overnight RP.

text.p: Economists expected the Federal Reserve would add reserves to the banking system at its usual midmorning intervention period Wednesday, though one called for the Fed to stay out of the system.

The Fed had a 14-day repurchase agreement (RP) running off the books, which was only partially offset by the settlement of the $1.49 billion coupon pass executed on Tuesday, said Marc Wanshel, economist with Morgan Guaranty Trust Co.

Wanshel said the add need should drop sharply on Thursday as a quarterly interest payment brings Treasury's cash balance at the Fed down to normal levels, but an additional $8.47 billion of three- and seven-day RPs will mature.
"We expect the Fed to add $4 billion or more to meet today's add need. It could clearly do so with an overnight operation, but we would not rule out a term RP (probably of eight days)," Wanshel said.
